meta.title: E20 · Proposed language adaptation / unrun
meta.subtitle: Static authored hypothesis map; arrows are not live traffic or scientific proof.

cards.title: Allowed stream · E20
items: E20 licensed prose / causal suffixes
E20 PROPOSED; NOT LOCKED/RUN
Gate: Pinned/licensed/group-disjoint allowed data only; no task/source IDs or future outcomes in routing; E20 suffix revealed only after saved prefix decisions.
Boundary: Untrusted corpus/user text -> approved, provenance-checked input; source metadata kept out of model decisions.
Failure: Deny suspect input/metadata, quarantine offending record and stop the relevant arm; preserve evidence. Exposed-final integrity correction requires a fresh experiment/test, not test repair.

cards.title: Frozen core · E20
items: Proposed frozen SmolLM2-1.7B
E20 PROPOSED; NOT LOCKED/RUN
Gate: Hash/freeze base tensors; preserve common-start outputs; no model code, tokenizer, evaluator or safety-gate edits. E19 freezing starts after A training, not pretrained initialization.
Boundary: Sandbox model/latent computations; read-only frozen base, no network or code/safety/evaluator mutation authority.
Failure: Retain the immutable reference/core state; mark the candidate or router failure. In a preregistered run, do not silently replace a failing arm with baseline output and call it success.

cards.title: Feedback monitor · E20
items: E20 proposed B3/D3 monitors
E20 PROPOSED; NOT LOCKED/RUN

Gate: Causal observed feedback and development-only thresholds; no oracle onset or final-score calibration; E19 strict timing gate stays failed. E20 B3/D3 candidate rules are not approval or a universal false-alarm guarantee.
Boundary: Observed outcomes from the allowed stream only -> detector; no final-test or oracle phase feedback.
Failure: No allowed causal trigger -> no allocation; score the unchanged system. False alarms, wrong routes and cap saturation remain recorded failures/diagnostics.

cards.title: Prefix router · E20
items: E20 proposed prefix GMM + slots
E20 PROPOSED; NOT LOCKED/RUN

Gate: Prefix/input-only routing, no true task/answer/test identity; log selections and independent oracle gap only as a diagnostic. If learned capability is accessible only with oracle routing, the autonomous system fails.
Boundary: Sandbox model/latent computations; read-only frozen base, no network or code/safety/evaluator mutation authority.
Failure: Retain the immutable reference/core state; mark the candidate or router failure. In a preregistered run, do not silently replace a failing arm with baseline output and call it success.

cards.title: Growth slots · E20
items: E20 proposed rank-8 clone / child
E20 PROPOSED; NOT LOCKED/RUN

Gate: Approved allocation cap and method-specific identity test; train only allowed new weights with logged causal exposure. E19 zero-init residual differs from E20 cloning; no claim that core freezing proves retention.
Boundary: Trainable candidate, bounded replay and causal keys only; no development/final data access.
Failure: Stop unsafe/nonfinite/over-budget candidate work, preserve partial logs and report failed/incomplete seed. No replacement seed or score-driven tuning.

cards.title: Replay control · E20
items: E20 R24 training-only reservoir
E20 PROPOSED; NOT LOCKED/RUN
Gate: Training-only bounded reservoir; log repeats, bytes and fresh-data tradeoff; charge replay work. Never replay development/final examples or silently add extra updates.
Boundary: Trainable candidate, bounded replay and causal keys only; no development/final data access.
Failure: Deny suspect input/metadata, quarantine offending record and stop the relevant arm; preserve evidence. Exposed-final integrity correction requires a fresh experiment/test, not test repair.

cards.title: Evaluator · E20
items: Proposed independent sealed custodian
E20 PROPOSED; NOT LOCKED/RUN

Gate: Separate custodian, real access isolation, immutable all-arm artifacts, one locked final transaction, no adaptive final queries, no post-hoc checkpoint/threshold choice. E19 official-test scoring was not a demonstrated ACL-enforced custodian seal.
Boundary: Independent custodian owns final data/evaluator; model artifacts cross read-only, never trainer-accessible final text or adaptive score queries.
Failure: Deny suspect input/metadata, quarantine offending record and stop the relevant arm; preserve evidence. Exposed-final integrity correction requires a fresh experiment/test, not test repair.

cards.title: Cost ledger · E20
items: Proposed end-to-end cost ledger
E20 PROPOSED; NOT LOCKED/RUN

Gate: Cost collector outside candidate write authority; count data, detector, routing, training and generation; reject NaN/missing/zero counts; equal steps do not prove equal compute. E19 records limited adaptation wall time, not full LLM/GPU cost.
Boundary: Protected measurement/record collector can observe candidates but candidates cannot rewrite measurement or outcome records.
Failure: Mark missing/malformed cost or scoring evidence INCOMPLETE; do not invent estimates or publish a pass.

cards.title: Public record · E20
items: E20 planned separate result section
E20 PROPOSED; NOT LOCKED/RUN

Gate: Per-EXX raw/protocol/source/verdict; preserve failures; separate task/model classes; sanitize licensed corpus/test content; human website PR and desktop/mobile/live-byte verification. A proposed graph is not a measured EXX result.
Boundary: Reviewed export -> public log; no raw sealed/licensed text, credentials or model-control channel.
Failure: Keep prior verified result release; correct/version the new export through review. A deployment failure means not live; old negative records remain visible.
